## Description and Rationale

I'm Feyyaz Orhan Toksöz from Ankara, Turkey, with a strong interest in software development and aviation. You can find more about me at fot.net.tr. I'm participating in this challenge to apply machine learning to a real-world aviation problem and combine my interest in aviation with data science.
